coordinates: glTF Y-up, front +Z; source dimensions and bind matrices unchanged

rendering.textures: Embedded base color/ORM/emission, source face half pixel-identical

fx_runtime_flags.alpha_override: None; both source FX materials remain opaque and visibility is toggled.

clips.original_legacy_useitem: Retained for rig compatibility; Stone Stomper has empty hands, no mining tool is spawned.
clips.shared_binding: Bind original node names directly; no retargeting or replacement clips. Shared scene remains external and need not be attached.

stomp.world_translation: Controller owns whole-instance translation and grounding; rig bones/clip unchanged.
stomp.support: Left sole remains at original ground; right sole lifts 0.155 source units and both return at release. Original sole baseline -0.0020254 source units, unchanged.
stomp.spawn_policy: Emit once per Stomp activation, only on successful ground contact at 0.625 s. Load optional FX on demand. Before release there is no visible effect.
stomp.interrupt: Before release: cancel pending event and hide FX. After release: stop future emits and hide any active FX immediately. No runtime alpha override is required. Skin/cuffs remain visible as equipment. On skin switch unload optional FX and detach any per-instance probes.
stomp.effect_position: Read live StoneImpact.matrixWorld at release, project onto controller/raycast ground. Preserve live X/Z; no cached rest world position.
stomp.effect_orientation: Identity world quaternion in glTF Y-up. Use ground normal only if deliberately supported later; never inherit animated foot tilt.
stomp.effect_scale: Same whole-instance scale as character; source FX template unchanged.

StonePalm_L.rest_frame: identity: +Y up/thumb, +Z outward palm or foot forward

StonePalm_R.rest_frame: identity: +Y up/thumb, +Z outward palm or foot forward

StoneImpact.rest_frame: identity: +Y up/thumb, +Z outward palm or foot forward
StoneImpact.effect_orientation: World Y-up after ground projection; do not inherit foot tilt.

socket_semantics.StonePalm_L/R: +Z outward palm, +Y thumb/up in bind glTF frame, +X character-left. These axes animate with original hand bones. For right-hand distal is -X. Empty anchors, no native cast/FX in Stone mode.
socket_semantics.StoneImpact: Child of foot.r at right sole. Live bone orientation available for foot attachments, while impact FX is explicitly world-up.
socket_semantics.FootFx: Original rig-local legacy marker retained unchanged for source compatibility; use live StoneImpact for new impact event.
socket_semantics.LeftFootSocket/RightFootSocket: Original ankle anchors retained bone-parented and live.

visibility.character_and_cuffs: always visible while Stone skin active

animation_blending: Preserve existing shared motion contract; fade Stomp in/out about 0.10 s. Abort pending landing event on transition. Actual controller/terrain blending is for later integration.
review: Artist personally checked all final GLB images; Root integration and final user approval are separate.
